title: Liz McBeth (CEO, Armour Valve) — 'so much of this book will stay with me. I can't recommend it highly enough.'
summary: Liz McBeth, CEO & President of Armour Valve Ltd, posts a LinkedIn endorsement of Incorruptible, reflecting on the book's treatment of Hubris Syndrome and the loss of curiosity and humility that can come with sustained power.
blockquote: I just finished reading Eric Ries' Incorruptible, and so much of this book will stay with me. I can't recommend it highly enough.
